abstract: —Iron–aluminium alloys display promising physical and mechanical properties. In this study, the efects of strain, strain rate and temperature on an Fe–8% Al were investigated. Hot torsion tests were performed in the temperature range 900–1100 -C and strain rate range 0.1–10 s<sup>-1</sup>. In this alloy, two types of dynamic recrystallization may operate during hot deformation: at high temperature and high strain rate, this alloy undergoes discontinuous dynamic recrystallization, whereas at lower temperature and strain rate, continuous dynamic recrystallization occurs  2012 Acta Materialia Inc. section_headings: Dynamic recrystallization mechanisms of an Fe–8% Al low density steel under hot rolling conditions
title: Dynamic recrystallization mechanisms of an Fe–8% Al low density steel under hot rolling conditions
